title: Browser Notification Monitor: RR LED Transitions and Fresh Signal Spotlight Events
changes: Page-open-only RR/browser notifications: notify on valid LED transitions, not every quote refresh; no cooldown.
Live Signal Spotlight notifications use first-seen NEW event IDs only; no prior events, context-only, or removed symbols.
No replay after Ctrl+F5, reload, version updates, initial load, missing or restored prices, or changes to RR thresholds.
Independent opt-in toggles, user-gesture permission request, permission status and test button.
Local seven-day event log, per-day long/short/radar frequencies, attempts and monitored-hour normalized statistics.
Same-origin coordination with browser Web Locks and localStorage avoids duplicate multi-tab event notifications where supported.
No Worker, R2, Telegram, existing RR rules, polling cadence or price feeds changed.
requiredDeploy: Overwrite only these seven MultiAssetLiquidityRadar frontend files; no Cloudflare Worker changes.
